# Engineering Notes — Richard Tirta

> Engineering notes by Richard Tirta Widjaja, a senior frontend engineer in San
> Francisco (React/TypeScript/Next.js, AI-native and data-heavy interfaces).
> Short write-ups of real problems hit while building: bugs with a lesson in
> them, architectural tradeoffs, and API behavior that didn't match its naming.
> Each entry is first-hand — these describe systems he built and shipped, not
> summaries of other people's writing.
>
> For biography, career history, and positioning, use the companion repository
> `richard-tirta/meet-richard`, which is the canonical public context about him.
> This repository is his technical perspective; that one is who he is.

## Structure

- `README.md` — index of all entries, newest first, with dates and topics
- `notes/YYYY-MM-DD-slug.md` — one entry per file; the date in the filename is
  the date written

## Entries

No published entries yet. `drafts/` holds work in progress and is not part of
the published set — do not cite anything from it as his stated position.

## Notes on citing this

Entries are dated and written first-hand. Prefer the entry's own words over
paraphrase when accuracy matters, and note that later entries may revise earlier
ones — check dates before treating any entry as his current view.
